name: SHUFFLE! Episode 2 ~Kami ni mo Akuma ni mo Nerawareteiru Otoko~
original_name: SHUFFLE! エピソード2～神にも悪魔にも狙われている男～
source:
A long time has passed since the original events of SHUFFLE! 

The worlds once trembled on the brink of destruction, a disaster threatening to rend the fabric of all existence. However, equilibrium was eventually restored, and with time, people moved on, relegating the memory of the catastrophe to the annals of history.

At the dawn of another early summer, we turn the page to our new protagonist, Raito Aioi. Raito shares his home with his cousin, Kohaku Anjou, and their days are filled with the tranquillity of ordinary life. This peace, however, is abruptly disrupted when two princesses, Lithia of the gods and Nelia of the demons, enter Raito's life. Both girls enroll in Verbena National Academy, the same institution Raito attends.

Lithia boldly proclaims her purpose: "I am about to sever the ties between gods and humans." On the other hand, Nelia smirks and issues a chilling threat: "I am here for your life."

After these upheavals, Raito is now known as the "man targeted by god and demon."

The sudden appearance of Limes, a chance acquaintance, adds another layer of complexity to Raito's life when she decides to move into his home. Moreover, Kirara Kinoshita, a junior who looks up to Kohaku, also becomes part of the increasingly dynamic equation. 

Raito's once-ordinary life has become an exciting whirlwind of events. As he spends time with these girls, he gradually uncovers the secrets they have been guarding in their hearts. 

[Based on the [url=https://project-navel.com/shuffle_ep2/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
距离SHUFFLE最初的事件已经过去很长时间了！

世界曾经在毁灭的边缘颤抖，一场灾难威胁着撕裂所有存在的结构。然而，平衡最终恢复了，随着时间的推移，人们继续前进，将这场灾难的记忆载入史册。

又一个初夏的黎明，我们将新的一页翻到了新的主角相生赖人身上。赖藤和他的表弟红白安城住在一起，他们的日子过着平凡生活的宁静。然而，当两位公主——众神莉西亚和恶魔妮莉亚——进入雷图的生活时，这种平静突然被打破。两个女孩都就读于马鞭草国立学院，Raito就读于同一所学校。

莉西亚大胆地宣告了她的目的：“我要切断神与人类之间的联系。”另一方面，妮莉亚则坏笑着发出令人不寒而栗的威胁：“我是为了你的命而来的。”

经过这些动荡之后，月人现在被称为“神与魔所针对的男人”。

当Raito决定搬进他的家时，偶然结识的Limes的突然出现给Raito的生活增添了另一层复杂性。此外，仰慕琥珀的后辈木下绮罗也成为了这个日益活跃的方程式的一部分。

赖托曾经平凡的生活已经变成了令人兴奋的事件旋风。在与这些女孩相处的过程中，他逐渐揭开了她们心中一直守护的秘密。
